name: Vibe-Trading
description: Trading research agent that turns plain-language requests into strategies, backtests and reports across stock and crypto markets.
whatItDoes: Writes and backtests strategies, benchmarks factor libraries, analyses a user's own trade history and exports reports. It targets quants and retail traders, with read-only broker connectors for portfolio views.
howItWorks: A Python CLI and web UI run an agent with market data sources, a backtest engine and grounding checks that verify reported numbers. Setup is interactive and writes an env file selecting the provider and model; it also runs as a stdio MCP server.

requirements.name: LLM provider credentials
requirements.description: Chosen during init via LANGCHAIN_PROVIDER and LANGCHAIN_MODEL_NAME

models: Multiple providers selected at init, including OpenAI Codex sign-in and Copilot
